positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerification
positions.frame: how is the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration established and verified against reference standards?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the calibration value (88.4 MHz) and src-2 asserts verification against the June reference plates across the full observing band — together they establish both the calibration result and the evidentiary basis for it under one directional read.
